ac:layout-cell.h1: Customer Onboarding and Connectivity Sequence and Reuse Assessment
ac:layout-cell.p: Summary — 037 · Customer paths — 038 · API and field changes — 040

Products: Sage 50, Sage 200, Sage Active and Sage X3 are the ERP products; Despachos is the accountant product. Each must meet the SXS and Tax integration precondition before enabling e-invoicing. SXS manages the product's datasetId / tenantId.
This view combines SPEC-SEI-021 and SPEC-SEI-036. It owns sequences, product impact and GAP decisions; 040 owns request/response examples. API/GAP IDs and predecessors are unchanged.
What: set up Sage access to the customer's selected e-invoicing platform. Why: reuse valid setup without repeated registration or an unintended provider change.

Phase coverage: 1 — SPFE public solution; 2 — external private providers; 3 — Sage private-platform offering. Labels show analysis coverage, not delivery approval or confirmed API availability. REF-PHASE.

What exists: the shared E-Invoice API can list services, find connections, connect, read status and update supported details. Proposal: reuse these calls and the Tax certificate capability. Add Spain rules and provider support where needed. The supplied contracts establish API behaviour; they do not prove a Spain implementation is ready. FR-01–05; REF-TRUST.

ac:layout-cell.p: The ERP actions correspond to the functional handoffs in SPEC038 §7. SPEC038 keeps the Customer, ERP and Domain Service swimlanes; these sequences expand the API boundary and supporting interfaces. They do not move customer interaction or permission decisions to another process. Reuse valid existing context and evidence; optional discovery is not a requirement to repeat every read.

Grey: existing calls. Blue: proposed Spain work. Red: open questions, uncertainty or assumptions requiring validation. Arrows show requests/responses; lanes show responsibilities. Keep returned datasetId, accessPointId and connectionId; never derive them from NIF. Diagrams do not establish deployments or production readiness.

Start after the product has integrated SXS and Tax certificate management / Connections Service, as required by 038 §4. The customer interaction in 038 ONB-01 selects the business, reviews current setup and confirms the action. The technical sequence below shows the internal prerequisites, not those customer screens. Resolve the selected company's SXS dataset/client mapping under its permitted access before dataset-scoped calls. If confirmed missing, complete qualified channel/SXS setup; an unavailable lookup remains pending with a next action and owner. After action confirmation, check NIF, action permission and any required credential. Keep each credential/connection reference with its source API; their ID relationship remains unconfirmed under GAP-06. Provision only a genuinely missing credential through 040 §2. The diagram proposes the call order, not new SXS or B2B Tax contracts. GAP-01/03/06; REF-INTEGRATION; REF-TRUST; INT-CERT01–03; SPFE-S02.

Existing API-02 returns access-point entries with connection references. INT-AP01–06 describe one connection per datasetId / accessPointId pair and several addresses inside a connection. The 040 API-02 Spain mapping is an unvalidated BA hypothesis; GAP-02 owns the decision. Keep service-returned IDs; do not assume one access point or connection equals one platform. Public/private coexistence remains subject to implementation evidence under GAP-01/02/06. A saved connection does not activate a route. FR-02; INT-AP01–06; REF-CONNECTIONS.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.2 Public readiness — Phase 1; reused in Phases 2–3
ac:layout-cell.p: For ONB-S02, reuse saved setup and check access for the selected public function under 038 ONB-04. CONNECTED does not prove public access. /connect is a Sage setup call, not an evidenced SPFE enrolment call. 040 §3 records the unconfirmed product interface; SPEC011 owns public transport rules. SPFE-S03/S08/S16.

What the nine WSDLs cover. The manifest selects the reviewed local PRE folder of 23 November 2026. None defines customer enrolment, NIF/census verification, mandate creation, certificate upload or an onboarding-status operation. The table maps these invoice operations to their owning feature; it does not add them to the onboarding sequence. Business purposes come from SPFE-S03 §§6.2–6.10; exact operation names and ports come from SPFE-S10–S17/S23.

ac:layout-cell.p: Access evidence and remaining gap. Each WSDL defines alternative certificate and electronic-seal ports. Use the exact port for the selected credential class and environment; certificate access does not prove authority for the represented business. There is no dedicated health/readiness operation in this bundle. GetInvoices and GetRegisteredInvoice have operation-specific roles and authority limits; neither is a confirmed onboarding probe. A successful authorised query can evidence that query's access only. An empty query result does not prove missing registration or permission for submission, download or reporting. SPFE-S03 §§4.3/6.4/6.5; SPFE-S10–S17/S23.

Under GAP-05/06, Public Integration and API owners must confirm the permitted check or other evidence for each requested function, credential/authority binding, result meaning and safe failure handling. AEAT liaison must confirm environment access. Until then, ONB-04 keeps the affected result unconfirmed with an action owner. Do not invent an AEAT method or make PRE validation a mandatory customer step. SPFE-S03 §6.10; proposed qualification control.

Reuse boundary. Reuse the shared scoped-readiness pattern and assess the actual SPEC011 client build. Keep Spain operation names, ports, authority rules and SOAP profile in the Spain binding. The eight invoice-operation WSDLs use SOAP 1.2 with ebMS headers and MIME attachments; ValidationInvoice uses direct Invoice/DocumentStatus SOAP bodies. Its two UBL schema imports now resolve locally; accepted-profile, schema provenance and client qualification remain open under SPFE-Q04/Q05. SPEC011 PCN-SPFE-R01–04/A01–04 own transport and client qualification; this inventory does not establish implemented coverage. SPFE-S10–S17/S23.

For ONB-S03, use API-01/02 only for missing, stale or changed service/setup information. Reuse valid setup; connect only if missing (API-03). Read progress (API-04) for pending work or missing/stale connection evidence. Check permission and routing effects first. A connected address does not activate a route.

The ONB-05 account decision distinguishes an existing account on the chosen platform from one requiring provider onboarding. API-03 is the Sage connection candidate; its 201 response does not prove completion of a provider's account onboarding. GAP-02/06/08 must confirm whether the qualified provider flow includes account creation or requires a separate customer/provider handoff. Keep unresolved account or onboarding evidence pending with an owner; do not invent another call.

The Phase 2 portfolio names B2B Router, Banqup (Unifiedpost), EDICOM, SERES (Docaposte) and ZeroComa. 040 also records Sovos as a new candidate from the Confluence review. Names do not prove Spain integration readiness; provider services, contracts and inputs remain GAP-02/06. REF-PROVIDERS.

The unlisted-provider decision is in 038 §3.2; the separate interconnection duty is in its operator handoff. Sage's operator role requires the PRD221 checks; customer connection success is insufficient.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.4 Supported change — Phases 2–3, enabled changes only
ac:layout-cell.p: The complete customer switch journey belongs to SPEC038. This section assesses its setup/API steps. Apply SPEC032 where old access or services end, within the same request. SPEC014 — Routing controls owns the effective routing change; do not create another switch process here.

The summary calls route activation Start or change platform use. Its ONB-07 decision follows either or both platform paths. A setup-only request returns results without changing any existing selection or activating a first one. The public/private paths may reuse valid setup for S05 and a ready S06 target; the requested change still needs its separate authority, readiness and effective-start checks. This wording does not introduce another API call or change the open contracts.

Change routing or platform — ONB-S05/S06: read existing setup first. If the chosen Spain model exposes another platform as a different accessPointId, API-03 is the candidate for its missing dataset connection (§3.3). Other mappings require contract assessment under GAP-02. Within an existing connection, API-05 adds an address (add) or changes address dates (update), including both in one request. Confirm Spain address/grouping rules and public access-point representation. Separately authorise the routing change and confirm its effective start and earlier-invoice access. SPEC014 — Routing controls owns those controls. Private A to Private B stays disabled; PUT does not establish a general migration or rollback.

Read the original connection before repeating an uncertain request. A failed or empty read does not prove no effect. While an address is RETRYING, observe it rather than submitting another connect. Keep unresolved work pending with an owner. INT-AP05/06. Recovery sequence.

For ONB-04, obtain these additional checks against the WSDL boundary. These are proposed acceptance controls, not AEAT response contracts.

tr.td: Existing public user, including an authorised accountant
Reuse suitable setup. No enrolment, invoice submission, cancellation or event report is sent to prove readiness. ONB-S02; SPFE-S10–S17.
Query succeeds with zero invoices
Retain the query result and scope. Do not infer missing customer registration or readiness for another operation. SPFE-S03 §§6.4–6.5; SPFE-S14/S15.
Certificate works but requested authority is missing; check times out or returns a fault
Do not mark the dependent function ready. Distinguish denied access from an unknown result; return correction or investigation with an owner. ONB-02/04/08; GAP-03/05/06.
PRE invoice validation succeeds
Record PRE validation evidence only. No production readiness or invoice registration follows; schema/profile and client qualification gates remain visible. SPFE-S03 §6.10; SPFE-S23; SPFE-Q04/Q05.
Spain client or credential binding changes
Qualify the selected certificate/seal port and build under SPEC011 PCN-SPFE-A01–04. Confirm client isolation and no change to another country's profile. GAP-06/08.
